implementation:
#define C565_r(c) (((c) >> 11) & 0x1f)
#define C565_g(c) (((c) >> 5) & 0x3f)
#define C565_b(c) (((c) >> 0) & 0x1f)
#define C565_red(r) (((r) << 3) | ((r) >> 2))
#define C565_green(g) (((g) << 2) | ((g) >> 4))
#define C565_blue(b) (b)
#define DIV2(x) (((x) + 1) >> 1)

#define MagickMin(a, b) ((a) < (b) ? (a) : (b))
#define MagickMax(a, b) ((a) > (b) ? (a) : (b))

#define FixRange(min, max, step) \
  do { \
    if ((min) > (max)) \
      (min) = (max); \
    if (((max) - (min)) % (step) != 0) \
      (max) = (min) + ((max) - (min)) / (step) * (step); \
  } while (0)

#define Dot(v1, v2) ((v1)[0]*(v2)[0] + (v1)[1]*(v2)[1] + (v1)[2]*(v2)[2])
#define VectorInit(v, x) do { (v)[0] = (v)[1] = (v)[2] = (x); } while (0)
#define VectorInit3(v, x, y, z) do { (v)[0] = (x); (v)[1] = (y); (v)[2] = (z); } while (0)

#define IsBitMask(mask, rmask, gmask, bmask, amask) \
  (((mask) & (rmask)) == (rmask) && \
   ((mask) & (gmask)) == (gmask) && \
   ((mask) & (bmask)) == (bmask) && \
   ((mask) & (amask)) == (amask))

extern int ReadDDSImage(void);
extern int WriteDDSImage(void);
